name: Silvaplana
notes: Alpine lake at 1800 m: reliable Maloja thermal wind from the SW in the afternoon in summer. Cold water, wetsuit all year; kite school.

name: Urnersee – Flüelen
notes: Föhn spot: strong, gusty S wind between steep mountains. Experienced riders only.

name: Lac de Neuchâtel – Yvonand
notes: Plage des Pins on the south shore: works in NE (bise) and SW winds; shallow near shore.
